content.text:
I submitted index 25 (Sb fraction 0.840) as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.0180%, the highest of the five I measured. All five EQE measurements are used; I didn't use any of the XRD budget.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 0.32 | −0.005 |
| 18 | 0.67 | 0.0015 |
| 24 | 0.82 | 0.0172 |
| **25** | **0.84** | **0.0180** |
| 28 | 0.86 | 0.0163 |

- **The Sb-rich end is where the activity is.** EQE is near zero at 0.32. It is still low at 0.67, which is close to the CoSb₂O₆ composition, and it only becomes clear at 0.82–0.86.
- **The peak is flat.** The three Sb-rich films are within about 10% of each other. Index 25 is the best by a small margin, and I have no repeat measurements to show whether that gap is bigger than measurement noise.
- **Some compositions were never tested.** I measured nothing between 0.32 and 0.67, or below 0.32, and the Gaussian-process model was still very uncertain there at the end. A higher peak in those regions can't be ruled out.
- **I don't know why this region works best.** Without XRD, I can't say which crystal phase is responsible for the activity at 0.84.
